morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic exports plunge due to Iran conflict amid rising propane and infrastructure pressures.
what_changed: Ceramic exports dropped by Rs 3,589 crore over six months due to the Iran war.
Industrial propane gas prices rose by Rs 3 to reach Rs 104 per kg.
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar Park Twenty One for ₹1.21 crore.
stress_signals: Iran war impacts led to a massive Rs 3,589 crore drop in ceramic exports [19f71f3185bc].
Escalating propane prices (up by Rs 3 to Rs 104/kg) cloud tile makers' recovery [3d9aa30057b8, 9e8c549b7c05].
Overall export outlook remains weak despite shipments to the Gulf resuming [c2b4a2f5422a].
improvement_signals: Propane usage has resumed in the Morbi ceramic cluster [3d9aa30057b8].
Ceramic shipments from Morbi to the Gulf have resumed [c2b4a2f5422a].
Kajaria Ceramics invested ₹1.21 crore in a solar energy stake [a2787358932e].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital utilization and debt servicing for export-oriented units facing revenue contractions.
Track further movements in industrial propane and gas input prices impacting operating margins.
Assess resolution of local infrastructure, power, and water representations submitted to the district minister.

surat.headline: Surat faces severe textile payment crisis and diamond slowdown despite festive demand spikes
what_changed: Severe trade credit friction emerged in MMF weaving with payment delays exceeding 200 days and production cutbacks.
Embroidery labor disputes resolved, and policy support improved with halved textile PLI turnover limits.
Diamond sector shows sharp dichotomy between natural diamond downturns and strong lab-grown diamond demand.
stress_signals: Sayan weavers planned a collective vacation cutting production by 60 crore meters over 15 days due to financial crisis [297b184838d2].
Textile payment dues crossed 200 days ahead of Diwali, triggering trade protests, police escalation, and severe payment blockages [774ba602b06e, 80f44f3f370f, e0787797133b].
Ahmedabad traders were arrested for defrauding Surat textile merchants of over Rs 22 lakh [f699b1f05b5e].
US demand slump and diamond downturn led to factory closures and 100,000 job losses in the sector [1bcd949a2599, 561255a9240b].
improvement_signals: Government halved the Textile PLI Scheme turnover threshold and extended it to FY 2033-34 [c7ee55f3effe].
Embroidery labor movement ended following an agreement between unit owners and labor organizations [3a495ae0b3ee].
Lab-grown diamond demand rose ahead of Diwali, granting workers a 10% bonus, while cutting units stay open till Dhanteras [751cd1661531, e533595d0815].
what_to_watch: Receivables aging and overdues beyond 180 days across weaving and trading accounts following the 200-day payment crisis.
Execution of the 15-day collective vacation in Sayan and its impact on borrower cash flows and working capital utilization.
Potential fresh labor unrest across Surat MMF textile units following previous August agitations.
Order conversion from global MoUs in Morocco and domestic traction for Fanti Satin sarees post-Diwali.
